title: A colour stays in the same section when you pick a second layer
goal: Right now, picking one box puts its fill colour in one part of the panel and picking a second box moves that same colour to a different part with a different name. The control you were just using jumps somewhere else the moment you add to the selection. It should stay put and simply start answering for everything you picked.
notes: Filed 2026-09-04 by the UX-PATTERNS scrub task. UX-PATTERNS.md section 4 now states the rule: a property keeps its home whatever the count, and a multi-select-only section is reserved for properties with no single-layer home (Arrange). The app violates it: InspectorSectionID.color (Sources/Photonz/LayersPanel.swift) is present only while several layers are picked and is documented in place as being on screen INSTEAD of the per-kind sections; SelectionColorInspector lives in Sources/Photonz/ColorStylePanel.swift, landed by commit 0af62a5. Audit queue/audits/2026-09-03-multi-style.json flags the same thing in its own rough: "the colour you were just editing moves to a different section when you shift-click a second layer". Likely shape of the fix: keep the per-kind section (Annotation/Text/Frame) on screen for a homogeneous multi-selection and make its colour rows answer for all of them, falling back to the whole-selection section only when the picked layers span kinds. Multi-layer colour logic already exists in core and should be reused, not rewritten.
acceptance: Picking one shape and then shift-clicking a second leaves the fill row under the same section heading it was already under, in the same place on screen
A row that describes several layers wearing different colours says Mixed, and setting it paints every one of them in one undo step, exactly as it does today
Saving a colour as a style and applying a style to everything picked are still reachable from that row, wherever it now lives
Picking layers of different kinds still shows a sensible place to set their shared colour, and that place is not a section that only exists during multi-select
docs/design/mocks/shared/UX-PATTERNS.md section 4 no longer carries the note saying the app does not follow this rule yet
